column7: setAccountStateInTx discarded the errors of its in-transaction PAT listing (pats, _ := tx.ListPersonalAccessTokensByUser) and of its session delete / PAT revocation savepoints (_ = tx.WithTransaction(...)). A failed revocation committed a suspension with the PATs still live in storage (usable again on reactivation) and a failed listing skipped the PAT cache eviction of a restriction, with nothing logged or audited. Each now runs in a savepoint with one retry; a persistent failure is reported after commit (per-user cache eviction, SECURITY log, EventSessionRevocationFailed) without rolling the state change back (TestRequirePasswordReset_PATListingTransientFault_IsRetriedAndEvicted, account_state_pat_failure_persistent_test.go).
